configure_ssd512_model: configure the SSD512 object detection model with 512x512 input size and 7 feature pyramid levels
build_voc_train_pipeline: build a training data pipeline for Pascal VOC with expand, random crop, resize, flip, and photo metric distortion
build_voc_test_pipeline: build a test data pipeline for Pascal VOC with resize and annotation loading
configure_voc_dataloader: configure a combined VOC2007 and VOC2012 dataloader with 10x repeat and batch size 8
configure_ssd_anchor_generator: configure SSD anchor generator with strides 8-512 and base size ratio range 0.15 to 0.9
